title: Lumen Alveary Patch
body:
# Lumen Alveary Patch

Makes ChromatiCraft Lumen Alveary bonuses work 24/7, even when bees aren't working.

## Features

* Lumen Alveary structure bonuses now apply continuously.

## How It Affects Your Experience

**Before:**
Lumen Alveary bonuses only worked when bees were actively producing (daytime, good weather).

**After:**
Bonuses are always active. Your bee setup maintains full efficiency 24/7, making the substantial investment in building a Lumen Alveary actually worthwhile.
